Horde Season 4 · Patch preview

Season 3 and Season 4 compared: boss order, enemy scaling, Tatari skills, chips, avatar frames, Spa buffs and the Camp Journal. The values below describe the update configuration; rollout may vary by server.

Rooster portraits

Camp Journal

The Camp Events module shows stage 2-40 as its unlock requirement. Open the Journal from camp to see story progress. Meet a story’s first requirement, then interact with its event bubble when it appears. Later chapters are gated by completion of the preceding event; the Journal tracks fragments and lets you claim the story reward when complete.

There are 17 configured stories with three parts each. Eligibility makes a story available to the event system; it does not guarantee that the event appears immediately.
